name: TIMWELL
recent: Timberwell 于 2026 年 11 月完成 1 拆 3 的股票分拆，分拆后股份于 11 月 24 日上市。公司于 11 月 19 日公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度业绩。执行董事 Wong Wai Foo 在 10 月至 11 月期间有多笔直接与间接持股的场外交易。
notable: 完成 1 拆 3 股票分拆，分拆后股份于 2026 年 11 月 24 日上市。
股东在 2026 年 11 月 3 日的特别股东大会上通过股票分拆及资本削减的特别决议。
公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度业绩。
risks: 执行董事 Wong Wai Foo 在 2026 年 11 月 12 日以场外交易方式直接增持 3,900,000 股（4.380%），同时间接减持同等数量股份。
执行董事 Wong Wai Foo 在 2026 年 10 月 13 日以场外交易方式直接增持 2,470,000 股（2.774%），同时间接减持同等数量股份。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度，营收为 MYR 2,619,000，环比增长 127.3%，但同比下跌 43.3%；净利为 MYR 359,000，净利率 13.7%，较去年同期的净利率 -96.4% 转正。

recent_en: Timberwell completed a 1-for-3 share split in November 2026, with the subdivided shares listed on 24 November. The company announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 19 November. Executive Director Wong Wai Foo had several direct and indirect share transactions via direct business transactions between October and November.
notable_en: Completed a 1-for-3 share split, with subdivided shares listed on 24 November 2026.
Shareholders passed special resolutions for the share split and capital reduction at the EGM held on 3 November 2026.
Announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026.
risks_en: Executive Director Wong Wai Foo acquired 3,900,000 shares (4.380%) directly and disposed of the same number indirectly via direct business transaction on 12 November 2026.
Executive Director Wong Wai Foo acquired 2,470,000 shares (2.774%) directly and disposed of the same number indirectly via direct business transaction on 13 October 2026.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 2,619,000, up 127.3% QoQ but down 43.3% YoY; net income was MYR 359,000 with a net margin of 13.7%, compared to a net margin of -96.4% in the prior-year period.
